title: Automatic Job Matching System
description: Tech Stack: PHP, HTML, CSS, WAMP, MySQL
longDescription: Developed a web-based Resume Builder and Automatic Job Matching System that helps job seekers create resumes and connect with suitable job opportunities. The system allows users to register, build resumes dynamically, and apply for jobs, while companies can post job requirements and view matched candidate profiles. Implemented keyword-based resume matching to automatically connect resumes with relevant job postings. Designed responsive user interfaces using HTML and CSS and managed backend operations and database connectivity using PHP and MySQL on the WAMP server environment.
achievements: Automatic resume-job matching based on skills and keywords

title: Multi-Tenant HR & Payroll Management System
description: Tech Stack: MERN Stack (MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, Node.js)
longDescription: Built a Multi-Tenant HR & Payroll Management System that enables multiple organizations to manage employees, attendance, payroll, and HR operations within a single platform while maintaining separate and secure data for each tenant. Developed RESTful APIs, implemented authentication and role-based access control, and created responsive frontend dashboards for HR management. Designed the system architecture to support scalability and secure tenant-based data isolation.
achievements: REST API development using Node.js and Express.js
MongoDB database integration for scalable data management
